API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APILog and Control ForwardingEc Rule Z Resource Get Ec Self Rule By ID
Ec Rule Z Resource Get Ec Self Rule By ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ecRules/self/:ruleId

Retrieves log and control forwarding rule configuration based on the specified rule ID.

⚠ This API endpoint is accessible only via OneAPI.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ruleId
int32
REQUIRED

ID of the rule.

Responses
​
default

default response
